Jamal’s spouse assisted the client in completing a 3-day diet history, which revealed an absence of fruits and 
vegetables, a high intake of foods containing processed sugar, and a minimal amount of fiber. Even though the client 
did not have an issue in any other prior visits, Jamal had become more depressed and started to drink alcohol. The 
client’s alcohol intake for the 3-day diet history was approximately a 6-pack of beer daily and a couple of bottles of 
wine over the 3 days. 
As a follow-up study, the health care provider ordered an amyloid PET scan. The results revealed tau proteins 
consistent with early Alzheimer’s disease.
